answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by binding each identity to a bonded stake verified through a hash trellis of prior attestations, so a single pearl of verified work cannot be cloned across many keys. Like sediment settling along a river, stake-weighted reputation accumulates only through distinct, costly participation, making mass identity creation economically irrational. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
